correctness.rationale: The exact inclusion-exclusion multiplier identity is derived from prescribed empty target sets; when n is odd every multiplier is odd. For even n>=4 and 1<=k<=n, the j=1 term has v2=1+v2(k), the j=0 term has strictly larger valuation, odd j>=3 terms have at least two more powers of two, and even j>=2 terms receive at least n additional powers from (n-j)^n. Thus no cancellation occurs at the leading 2-adic order. Character multiplicities and determinant valuation follow from the full orthogonal Walsh basis. n=1 and n=2 are checked separately. A standalone program enumerates all maps n<=6 and verifies every degree through n=120 (15,137 assertions), not as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The vacancy profile is a canonical distribution from finite uniform mappings. Exact degree-by-degree 2-adic valuations across every dimension provide a natural complete classification of Fourier recovery, its unique singular order, and all dyadic determinant/multiplicity levels. This strong arithmetic invariant is not supplied by occupancy variance or ordinary limit theorems; its all-dimensional character makes it useful for structural convolution and modular spectral analysis. The result does not need an unrelated downstream theorem to be meaningful.
